note: SHA-256 digests of literal values that no shared file may spell out and no rule may name: lower-cased, NFKC-normalised email tokens (kind email) and letter-and-digit word tokens (kind word). private/bin/relational-scan.ts compares every token's digest with these. Add a value with `bun private/bin/relational-scan.ts add-literal`, which reads it from standard input and never prints it. Allow entries have the denylist's shape, with rule relational/l<NN>.
